title: Does joint potassium–total-CO2 encoding improve albuminuria prediction? An exploratory cross-cycle transfer test
abstract: In exploratory NHANES 2009–2010 to 2015–2016 transfer (n=4510/4208), adding a potassium-by-total-CO2 spline surface changed weighted log-UACR MSE from 0.796694 to 0.852541, delta +0.055846 (joint PSU-bootstrap 95% [+0.023206,+1.541964]). The registered improvement criterion failed.
